data.action: 魔法少女变身，星尘光阵展开
data.description: 阴暗狭窄的雨后小巷深处，面对强大的敌人，白夜毫不犹豫地高举法杖展开耀眼的星尘变身魔法阵。绚丽的魔法光芒驱散了所有的阴霾与潮湿，她神情凛然地护在身后的人面前——「只要我还站在这里，就绝对不会允许任何人夺走大家的笑容与日常！」
data.promptProse: Byakuya raises her star wand into the glowing magic circle, her pale twin buns and pink frilled dress illuminated by the transformation. Just behind her, a dark-haired person in a mustard jacket shelters close to the brick wall, face visible past the wings. The danger is down the alley in the direction of her wand, and light from the circle reflects across the puddles.
data.title: 深森白夜 · 雨中小巷·魔法少女变身与星尘阵
data.animaCaption: Byakuya raises the star wand in front of a dark-haired bystander crouching in a mustard jacket by the brick wall. The light from her magic circle reaches both figures as she faces the danger down the alley.
